title: Add admin training workbench with live run telemetry
description: Provide a first-class admin UI for local training runs, progress streams, context/VRAM guidance, and safe model promotion workflows.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from UX supplement review; intended to dogfood training operations in-app and reduce terminal-only operational burden.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Delivered first admin-visible workbench slice at `/training-workbench` with readiness diagnostics for transcript/feedback toggles, export/runs paths, Python venv + harness script presence, and run status artifact table from `status.json` files. Added governance navigation link and route-level admin policy. Follow-up scope is live run trigger/streaming event tail and promotion controls.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed standalone-first training UX pass. `/training-workbench` now surfaces live telemetry depth from `events.jsonl` and `benchmark.json` (event timestamp, throughput, final loss, and latest event feed), while remaining separate from admin tabs. Added route/security contract tests (`TrainingWorkbenchPage_WithAnonymousAdminConfig_DoesNotRenderWorkbenchForSignedOutUser`, `TrainingWorkbenchPage_AdminSession_ReturnsHeading`) and updated nav/admin markup guards (`TagGovernanceTests`). Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~TagGovernanceTests|FullyQualifiedName~CodeSearchPageRoute_ReturnsSuccessAndContainsHeading|FullyQualifiedName~TrainingWorkbenchPage_WithAnonymousAdminConfig_DoesNotRenderWorkbenchForSignedOutUser|FullyQualifiedName~TrainingWorkbenchPage_AdminSession_ReturnsHeading"` => 37 passed, 0 failed.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Finalized first-class workbench readiness by adding artifact actions (copy/open status, events, benchmark) so operators can transition from telemetry viewing to direct artifact inspection without leaving the UI. Added shared regression guard for actionable controls in `TagGovernanceTests.CodeSearchAndTrainingWorkbenchMarkup_ExposeActionableCopyAndOpenControls`; focused validation now reports 38/38 passing.
